findings.message: Gateway auth is off or missing a token.
findings.fixHint: Run `openclaw doctor --fix --generate-gateway-token` to generate a token, then restart the Gateway.

findings.fixHint: Run `openclaw configure` and set Gateway mode (local/remote), or `openclaw config set gateway.mode local`.
